name: @tylerbu/tidepool
description: A Fluid Framework server for Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, and R2

JWT_SECRET.description: **Supply your own signing key.** Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32` (at least 32 UTF-8 bytes). Enter it here as a runtime secret, keep a secure backup, and use the same key in your trusted JWT issuer. Tidepool does not generate this key or issue document JWTs.

TENANT_ID.description: Tenant for this Tidepool. Defaults to `fluid`; document JWTs must use this tenant.

CONTENT.description: R2 bucket for document content and the document directory. Cloudflare provisions this bucket in your account.

DOCUMENTS.description: SQLite-backed Durable Objects for document sequencing, state, and connections.

scripts.build: pnpm build:protocol && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist && pnpm build:admin
scripts.check: biome check src test scripts package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts && cd protocol && gleam format --check src
scripts.format: biome check --write src test scripts package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts && cd protocol && gleam format src
scripts.test: pnpm test:protocol && pnpm test:workers && pnpm test:acceptance
